text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Line: median over the cold winter nights of winters 2023-24 to 2025-26; band: 25th to 75th percentile. Cold nights are the coldest 10% of days by daily mean temperature. The baseline forecast is experiment 114's day-ahead forecast; D9 has no stored forecast for these winters. Points are 1% of each substation's 99th percentile of demand.'
